currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Entropiebeiträge diskutieren und mithilfe der Gibbs-Helmholtz-Gleichung Aussagen zur Spontanität treffen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can discuss entropy contributions and make statements about spontaneity using the Gibbs-Helmholtz equation.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: System- und Umgebungsentropie gemeinsam betrachten und mit freier Enthalpie thermodynamische Richtung von Geschwindigkeit unterscheiden.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Consider system and surroundings entropy together and use Gibbs energy to distinguish thermodynamic direction from speed.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Entropiebeiträge einschließlich endothermer Gegenfälle begründen und bei angegebenen T,p-Bedingungen mit ΔG prüfen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Explain entropy contributions including endothermic contrasts and check them using ΔG under stated T,p conditions.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Lokale Entropieabnahme, statistische Modellgrenzen und tatsächlichen endothermen Lösungsvorgang voneinander abgrenzen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Distinguish local entropy decrease, statistical model limits and an actual endothermic dissolution.

rationale: Personally read the whole current DE/EN title/description/requires/context. Entropy contributions and the Gibbs criterion form one thermodynamic driving-force judgment. All nonresource goal fields are exact against the original reviewed eleven. There is no goal-text or prerequisite change to approve here. Personally reread the complete current P1 profile, all three whole bilingual cases, supplied data, model answers and four-point rubrics. Full profile body is exact against the original. Freezing model gives total entropy +1.08/-1.31 J/(mol K), Gibbs -280/+380 J/mol at 260/290 K. The four-particle positional model gives W=6, 6/16=0.375 and kB ln6 approximately 2.474e-23 J/K; it is explicitly not molar reaction entropy. The separate chemical model gives total +10 J/(mol K)/-3 kJ/mol. Actual supervised endothermic dissolution still requires original execution, controls, repeats and raw temperature data; separate synthetic 293.15-K model gives surroundings -67.13/total +12.87 J/(mol K) and -3772 J/mol. No supplied model values are relabeled measured or learner evidence. The new visualization does not change these assessment demands or clear a larger source clause. Personally counted exactly six same blue particles in each left-hand container. Larger positional space and 'Mehr zugängliche Zustände' form an explicitly labeled gas-model entropy illustration; no extra species or particles appear. It illustrates the configurational contribution rather than proving an arbitrary real expansion process's complete entropy balance. The dotted divider and separate right-hand heading distinguish that model from the Gibbs panel; constant T,p is not imposed simultaneously on the expanding fixed-N gas. The right equation ΔG=ΔH−TΔS and negative/zero/positive actual reaction-Gibbs criteria are coherent. No standard-state superscript is shown, so zero is read as the actual equilibrium criterion, not as ΔG°=0 at every composition. 'Spontan ≠ schnell' and 'Auch endotherm möglich' now explicitly prevent the original generic-energy-release and kinetics misconceptions. The former controlled-comparison/energy-release image holds are resolved for this exact new asset. Personally inspected the actual single native goal page 3 from the normal D1 PDF preview, the full exact PNG, and my actual 360/680 Chromium frames. Title, complete goal ID, description and checked external enthalpy prerequisite/assessment successor fit on one page without clipping. The equation, particle-count/model motif, sign boxes and spontaneous/endothermic qualification are readable in my 328x246 image frame at viewport360; at680 the frame is597x448.
